 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Banner nights are always special for championship-winning teams, especially when a franchise has waited decades to reach the top. The New York Knicks know that feeling all too well, ending their 53-year championship drought last season.
 With their passionate fans known for wearing their hearts on their sleeves, emotions ran high on Tuesday night as the banner was raised in the rafters. That was clear when comedian and longtime Knicks fan Tracy Morgan stirred things up by taking a shot at Bronny James .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement With LeBron James now playing for the Philadelphia 76ers, Morgan seemed determined to get under the skin of the 41-year-old forward before tip-off.
 Tracy Morgan went after Bronny 
 LeBron reportedly signaled his interest in joining the Knicks during the 2026 offseason but ultimately didn't move to New York. Instead, he joined the Sixers, adding another superstar to Philly's already-stacked roster.
 That decision gave Knicks fans another reason to target King James.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement As a result, during the banner-night festivities, Morgan delivered a blunt assessment of Bronny's basketball abilities as the hosts, caught off guard, failed to contain their laughter.
 "We're scared of nobody. Bronny look like he got JUCO ball written all over him," Morgan said as Carmelo Anthony laughed . "I just wanna say what I feel. What you want?" 
 Morgan's remarks were clearly intended to provoke a reaction from the crowd and get a laugh, not start a beef with the four-time MVP.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Related: Radio host urges Bronny James to quit basketball after JJ Redick's criticism: "Go start a tech company" 
 King James delivered 
 Now, whether Morgan's jab reached LeBron or not, the four-time NBA champ made his presence felt on the court.
 He didn't just sacrifice throughout his 34 minutes on the floor by scoring just 14 points; he left his imprint in other ways, dishing seven assists and grabbing nine rebounds, along with a steal and a block.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Most importantly, he went from scoring momentum-changing buckets in the third quarter to making a decisive block on Mikal Bridges with less than a couple of minutes remaining, to knocking down the game-sealing free throws.
 The standout performance came from the player with the closest bond to the James family: Tyrese Maxey, who dropped a game-high 28 points with three steals and three blocks.
 On the other hand, Jaylen Brown dropped 19 in his first official performance for the 76ers, while Joel Embiid was exceptional with his 13 points, 11 rebounds, and three blocks.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 76ers spoil banner night 
 For the Sixers, a balanced starting lineup ensured a 106-00 win, rather than letting Morgan have the last laugh.
 That said, while the Knicks dropped their opening contest, their fans should avoid instigating opponents, especially as the Eastern Conference has gotten deeper.
 In contrast, Philly has plenty of positives to take away from this, as they overcame a halftime deficit to win in front of a hostile crowd.
